description: Assigns a role to a user within the same organization and branch.
validation: userId must reference an existing user belonging to organizationId + branchId (user_id NOT NULL)
roleId must reference an existing role belonging to organizationId + branchId (role_id NOT NULL)
user and role must belong to the same organization + branch
(user_id, role_id) pair must not already exist (PRIMARY KEY user_id, role_id)

errors.condition: userId is missing / does not reference an existing user in scope
roleId is missing / does not reference an existing role in scope
organizationId or branchId does not exist

constraints: user_id NOT NULL, role_id NOT NULL

notes: The user_roles primary key is (user_id, role_id) only - it does not include organization_id/branch_id, so uniqueness of an assignment is enforced globally on the user/role pair rather than per-tenant. This matches the 'Duplicate user-role -> Primary key constraint rejected' result in the API Test Results sheet (API-T023) and requires no additional gap flag since the same user_id/role_id pair cannot legitimately exist in two different org/branch scopes anyway (users and roles are themselves org/branch-scoped).
